question: Which two retained native bulk mRNA sources are genuinely ready to assess the exploratory GPNMB EMC-versus-LGFMS/MLPS association and its strongest interpretation-changing alternatives?
scope: Source identity, complete eligible conditions, assay units, comparator/donor mapping, target annotation and computability only. No gene outcomes/statistics.
selection_rule: Mandatory relevance and capacity to test interpretation, not favorable GPNMB sampling. Prefer complete public processed native tissue mRNA with explicit specimen identities and within-assay fixed controls; retain all broader relevant gaps.
source_choices_prospective: Reuse frozen gpnmb_broader_coverage_gate and all R1-R9 source decisions, beginning Davis6/5QC and Zullow7/11 annotations/units.
If neither provides ready target/condition/control mapping, evaluate Brenca12+paired and Ngo external1041/older array contexts from existing sources only; no unchanged source retry.
strongest_alternative: Bulk stromal/cell-mixture, preparation/assay or donor-reuse effects could explain a tissue contrast. Culture observations are separate and cannot be pooled tissue or force a universal protein/pairing veto.
stop: 20-minute finite readiness decision, at most two recommended numerical inputs. No values without a separately frozen authorized numerical follow-up. Unresolved suitable accessible sources remain pending and block promotion.
restrictions: No new targets/ranking/thresholds; no new gene values, matrices or statistics.
No denied FAP-tissue/glycan/HLA/structural-genomics/fusion-form/topology scope or access bypass.
8MiB new retained originals cap;10GiB free floor; originals/cache-only derivatives ignored; preserve prior freezes.
